'''2009 Worlds Day 3 Joe Olson DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joe Olson]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 3).<ref name="pdf">[http://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2009/Worlds/2009+Worlds+D3.pdf 2009 Worlds Day 3.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org, pages 12, 13, 14. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008205435/http://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2009/Worlds/2009+Worlds+D3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

The list is a typed sheet headed "Joe Olson Worlds Day 3 DS", which begins on page 12 below the end of his Light list. Where the sheet does not identify a card version ("EPP Maul (v)", "Darth Maul", "EPP Vader", "4-Lom w/ Gun", "Maul's Ship", "Aiii Aiii Aiii", "Emperor's Shuttle"), the entry is left unlinked as written.

== Deck info ==

* '''Side:''' Dark
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Knowledge And Defense (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
